svg.title: Delete a ticket — SoftTrack web design mockup (#158)
svg.desc: The ticket panel and page gain Delete ticket in the ⋯ menu. A confirmation dialog names what goes with the ticket and what stays, then the board shows it gone.
svg.text: · from the ⋯ menu, behind one confirmation
The ⋯ menu on a ticket gains “Delete ticket…”
panel shown; the ticket page carries the same menu

g.text: Safari drag ghost offset on scrolled columns
Dragging a card on a column that has been scrolled leaves the drag ghost offset by
the column's scroll position. Chrome and Firefox are fine.

svg.text: The API already deletes a ticket (DELETE /tickets/{ticket_id}: attachments go with it and sub-tickets are promoted, see app_softtrack/tickets.py). This is the missing way in from
the UI. The bulk bar’s Delete still uses window.confirm, and could move to this dialog with the counts summed.
